About Us

Architectural Designing

Nearing Two Decades

K Arch Architects is a multidisciplinary Mumbai-based architectural firm founded by promising young architect Ar. Pravin Eknath Khade in the year 2012.

The design portfolio of K Arch Architects demonstrates ingenuity through its creative designs which are innovative, customized, and diverse in nature which includes residential, commercial, high rise structures, institutional and re-development projects.

At K Arch Architects, we provide you with customized, cost-effective, and functional design solutions with an aesthetic touch irrespective of the scale. Our approach is simple yet unique. We do not opt for standardized architecture with pre-conceived notions instead we develop design solutions that integrate form and function contemplating architecture and landscape best suited to each project striving to produce designs that are relevant, client-centric and feasible as per environmental and climatological parameters.

Our motto is to explore & achieve value-based innovative designs surpassing the boundaries of construction techniques and material to enliven and enrich a sustainable built environment.

Design Ethos

Philosophy

K Arch Architectural Firm is instinctively progressive, dedicated, flexible, and innovative in providing holistic design solutions. Our efficiency in design planning is our unique forte.

We deliver our creative inputs, devote time and energy right from the conceptual design stage to construction administration and post-occupancy with complete assurance that your business idea gets built on strong foundations and succeeds throughout its lifespan.

With aspirations to nurture a long-term relationship with every client and end-user, we strongly believe in bridging the barriers between the different construction disciplines by adopting a collaborative process between clients, consultants, in-house team, and end-users, we at K Arch Architects prefer to work as an integrated team rather than work in isolation remotely.

Our unique integrated design approach enables us to develop strategies that focus on the future of a sustainable built environment. Ours is a firm that exclusively involves the approval authority consultants, structural consultants, MEP consultants and site engineering team, and sales team right from the conceptual phase of the project.
